snippet.title: KOPI - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Baristas, Welcome to KOPI!

Brew, Serve and Get more stars!
Team up or go solo in this fast-paced, family friendly café simulation game from Dream On A Stick, in which you experience the challenge of being a barista across many different environments.

Whether you're a latte artist, social gamer or a high score challenger, master wild coffee orders while watching out the collapsing espresso machine, the burning milk and VERY impatient customers.

------------------
WHY PLAY?

Co-op Chaos: Play solo or team up locally/online with a partner – perfect for couples, friends, or family bonding (or breaking 😉)

Rising Challenges: Start with simple Americano, unlock complex recipes like Marshmallow latte, but beware kitchens get wilder every level!

4 Unique Scenes:
Park: Start your day with sunrise brews in an open-air café – breezy vibes meet endless streams of "Americano" orders.
Home kitchen: Cook chaos in a realistic home kitchen – where the coffee grinder competes with guests' pressure. Perfect for dragging siblings/parents into the madness!
Cabin: Who says no to marshmallow-roasting by the fireplace? Warmer atmosphere, trickier recipes – just don’t burn the s’mores in this cramped space!
Diner: Glossy counters, brighter lights, and Fast-Food. Master the art of whipping up burger-coffee combos like a pro – but be quick, or you’ll drown in orders!

------------------
📆Launching April 2025 - Wishlist Now!
Steam: bit.ly/KOPISteam
Languages: English, 中文（简体）, Czech

------------------
About Dream On A Stick:

Nestled in the heart of Manchester’s creative hub, DREAM ON A STICK was born in 2021 from the shared dreams of two friends, one hailing from the vibrant streets of Malaysia and the other from the historic charm of the Czech Republic. United by a shared passion for gaming and a deep-rooted friendship, our studio embodies a fusion of diverse cultures and creative visions.

------------------
Don't forget to

Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Dream-on-a-Stick/61566639818948/
